summary: Keep the native Mac panel anchored and load signed app resources correctly

schema.detail: No daemon or generated-client contract changes.

rules.detail: Attention and human-review rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The native panel retains its menu-bar anchor while resizing. App resources resolve inside the signed bundle; standalone SwiftPM and gallery resource lookup remains supported.

manual.detail: No user migration is required. Native panel diagnostics are opt-in.

recovery.detail: Restore the prior app package pin to roll back; daemon state is unchanged.
